## Heading

This filter adds additional options to citations.

Here are the options provided by Quarto/Pandoc:

- Narrative Citation: @bergelson_1996
- Suppress Author: -@bergelson_1996
- Add Locator: @bergelson_1996 [Section 1]
- Parenthesised Citation: [@bergelson_1996]
- Parenthesised Citation with Locator: [@bergelson_1996, Section 1]

Here are the expanded options:

- Remove Parentheses (Author Only): [@bergelson_1996]{.remove-paren}
- No Parentheses: [@bergelson_1996]{.no-paren}

The default options can be mixed and matched with the expanded options.

Below is an example in using .no-paren:

::: {#def-Density}
## [[@bergelson_1996, Section 1]]{.no-paren}

We call define *density of a subset $A\subseteq G$ with respect to a Følner sequence, $\Phi$,* as
$$d_\Phi(A)=\lim_{N\rightarrow\infty}\frac{|\Phi_N\cap A|}{|\Phi_N|},$$
if it exists.
:::
